_meta.description: Crop, companion and pollinator reference data for EcoFarm Advisor. Emission and agronomy values are indicative and should be validated by local agricultural experts.
_meta.crop_base_emission_kg_co2e_per_ha: Typical crop-specific field emissions per season (e.g. methane from flooded rice, residue and soil N2O), excluding fertilizer, irrigation energy and machinery fuel which are calculated separately.
